implemented: Shared topCatapultPlant chooses coffee, normal, pumpkin, underplant; acquisition and physical basketball impact use it.
FindCatapultTarget skips standalone spikes when selecting a candidate. A flowerpot in that same cell can qualify, then GetTopPlantAt returns the supported spike; this source exception is preserved.
Mapped catapults check integer attack rectangle rawX+10,width133 against plant rectangle, requiring overlap>=20; the first eligible cell is processed, including while shooting/reloading.
Direct drive-over targets exclude kelp, spikes, cherry, jalapeno, blover and squash, and awake ice/doom. Sleeping ice/doom can be crushed.
Squishing a selected cell processes all on-ground layers, preserves spikes and an already-activated squash, and immediately triggers awake bombs and armed mines.
Existing special effects were moved without changing their damage, masks or RNG to doSpecial so timed activation and pressure share the same effect code.
testExpectationCorrection: airborne-plant.test.ts previously expected a grounded prelaunch squash to be destroyed by a catapult. CanTargetPlant(DRIVE_OVER) explicitly excludes squash; the expectation now preserves it, while ordinary plant crushing and other ground/air positive controls remain. No game seeds, normal-play player strategies or pinned golden hashes were changed.
remaining: This contact port applies to mapped catapults; zomboni, sled and giant contact paths still need separate native mapping.
Five-second flattened-plant visuals and original death/particle effects remain incomplete. The browser shows generic yellow circles rather than native Powie.
Special-plant damage masks/ranges remain the existing partial model; sharing activation code does not prove complete native DoSpecial parity.
Final-ball timing, chilled animation cycles, float32/update ordering, and physical-device performance remain incomplete.
